metadata_consistency.note: station_information.csv is a *filtered* subset of stations; zone-information.charge_count is the authoritative zone total. The zone total is used as the predictor, station count only as a secondary descriptor.

excluded_from_predictors.TAZID: zone label; numeric ordering is meaningless
excluded_from_predictors.station_id: station label; aggregated to a zone count instead
excluded_from_predictors.occupancy.csv: contemporaneous observation of the predicted hour (would leak)
excluded_from_predictors.duration.csv: contemporaneous observation of the predicted hour (would leak)

leakage_notes: all zone features are static administrative attributes
no timestamp-dependent quantity from the raw source is joined
join validated as many_to_one; row count preserved
